==English== {{wp}} {{commonscat}} {{wikidata lexeme|L4615}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{l|en|insuraunce}} {{qualifier|obsolete}} ===Etymology=== From the older form ''[[ensurance]]'', see also ''[[assurance]]''. {{surf|+af|en|insure|-ance}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{a|en|RP}} ** {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈʃɔː.ɹəns/|a=pour-poor}} ** {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈʃʊə.ɹəns/|a=non-pour-poor}} * {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈʃʊɹ.əns/|/ɪnˈʃɜɹ.əns/|a=GA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-insurance.ogg|a=California}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Grendelkhan-insurance.wav|a=Connecticut}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɪn.ʃə.ɹɪns/|a=chiefly,Southern US}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-insurance.wav|a=Texas}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɪn.(t)ʃuː.ˈrens/|/ˈɪn.(t)ʃoː.ˈrens/|a=India}} * {{hyph|en|in|sur|ance}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|-|s}} # {{senseid|en|Q43183}}A means of [[indemnity]] against a future occurrence of an uncertain event. #: {{ux|en|The car was totalled, but fortunately I had '''insurance'''.}} #* {{quote-journal |en |date=2012-01 |author=Philip E. Mirowski |title=Harms to Health from the Pursuit of Profits |volume=100 |issue=1 |page=87 |magazine=w:American Scientist |url=http://www.americanscientist.org/bookshelf/pub/harms-to-health-from-the-pursuit-of-profits |passage=In an era when political leaders promise deliverance from decline through America’s purported preeminence in scientific research, the news that science is in deep trouble in the United States has been as unwelcome as a diagnosis of leukemia following the loss of health '''insurance'''. |accessdate=14 May 2013 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120404223121/http://www.americanscientist.org/bookshelf/pub/harms-to-health-from-the-pursuit-of-profits |archivedate=4 April 2012 }} # The [[business]] of providing insurance. #: {{ux|en|After five years in banking, I switched to '''insurance'''.}} # {{lb|en|figurative}} Any [[attempt]] to [[forestall]] an [[unfavorable]] [[event]]. #: {{ux|en|The sky was clear, but I took my umbrella for '''insurance'''.}} # {{lb|en|blackjack}} A bet made after the deal, which pays off if the [[dealer]] has [[blackjack]]. #: {{ux|en|I only take '''insurance''' if the count is right.}} # {{lb|en|countable}} An [[insurance policy]]. # {{lb|en|countable}} A company providing insurance policies; an [[insurer]]. #* {{RQ:Bramah Max Carrados Mysteries|passage='They don't say so yet, but the suggestion is incendiarism. {{...}}'
